name: Friday Saturday Sunday
changeNote: Gained its first star in the first guide to cover Philadelphia

menus.name: Chef's tasting menu
menus.note: Paid in advance when booking; served in the upstairs dining room.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Each month's tables open on the 1st of the month before at 10am Philadelphia time, and the tasting menu is paid in advance.
walkIns: The ground-floor Lovers Bar serves cocktails without a booking. Guests who can't manage the stairs (there is no lift) can eat the full dinner menu at the bar, first come, first served.
groups: The largest table seats four. Private events are rarely possible because the restaurant is so small; ask by email at info@fridaysaturdaysunday.com.
children: Children under five are asked not to come, given the length of the meal.
